summary: Frontend-only E2E validation of Lot Sécurité 2 (SEC-001 file-token + logout revocation, SEC-002 upload validation) on the preview URL. 12/13 checks passed. Verified: login → dashboard (no blocking console errors); /vehicules list (12 rows); vehicle drawer → Documents tab (9 folders); PDF upload in 'Divers' → success toast + doc listed; preview opens with 200 on /api/files (iframe src contains ?token= that is NOT the session JWT); download link returns 200 application/pdf with 'attachment' Content-Disposition and X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff; document deletion OK (no TEST_ leftovers, verified across all vehicles via API); forbidden .txt upload → backend 400 + French error toast, no crash, no doc added; reports (conformite.pdf, couts.csv, vehicule/{id}.pdf) all open with the short-lived file token → 200 with correct content-types, while the SAME endpoint with the session JWT in ?token= returns 401 (query-token scope enforced); navigation /vehicules → /timeline → /alertes → / with no spurious redirect to /login; logout → /login, localStorage.lt_token cleared, and the OLD captured session token returns 401 on /api/auth/me (real server-side revocation via token_version); re-login works immediately after.

ui_bugs.issue: Escape key does not close the preview dialog when a PDF is displayed (focus is captured by the <iframe>, so the Radix Dialog never receives the keydown). The X button and overlay work. Minor UX: user must click X.

action_items: Optional (LOW): make FilePreview closable with Escape while a PDF iframe is focused (e.g. keydown listener on window while dialog is open).
critical_code_review_comments: api.js withToken() silently returns the URL WITHOUT a token if fileToken is still null (e.g. if /auth/file-token failed at bootstrap). The resulting /
DropZone accept list in DocFolderSection.jsx (line 60) omits 'gif' and 'webm' which the backend allowlist accepts — harmless but inconsistent with the server allowlist.

DocFolderSection.handleDelete has no try/catch: a failing DELETE would throw an unhandled promise rejection and show a false 'Document supprimé' toast path only on success, but no error toast on failure.
seed_data_creation: Uploaded then deleted a single test PDF (TEST_qa_doc.pdf) in folder 'Divers' of vehicle '1-Enyaq 01 Bern'; a rejected TEST_bad.txt was never stored. Verified zero TEST_* documents remain across all 12 vehicles. No business data modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: No vehicle in the fleet currently has a photo hosted on /api/files (all thumbnails are external Unsplash URLs), so the ?token= assertion on could not be exercised on /vehicules; it was validated instead on the document preview iframe and on report links. PDF previews render blank in headless Chromium (no PDF plugin) — verify via network status (200) and iframe src, not visually. Reminder: logout revokes all superadmin tokens, so run revocation tests last and re-login after; login lockout is 5 fails/15 min.
rca_of_the_issue: Escape-not-closing: the PDF <iframe> inside the Radix DialogContent takes keyboard focus, so the dialog's onEscapeKeyDown handler never fires. Not a security or data issue.
